license_required.quote: No person shall practice medicine and surgery, or any of its branches, without the appropriate license or certificate from the state medical board

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine
degree_required.quote: Hold a diploma from a medical school or osteopathic medical school that, at the time the diploma was issued, was a medical school accredited by the liaison committee on medical education or an osteopathic medical school accredited by the American osteopathic association

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education or American Osteopathic Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the liaison committee on medical education or an osteopathic medical school accredited by the American osteopathic association

required.quote: have successfully completed not less than twelve months of graduate medical education through the first-year level of graduate medical education or its equivalent

duration.value: 12 months minimum (first-year level) or 24 months for foreign medical graduates (second-year level)
duration.quote: not less than twelve months of graduate medical education through the first-year level of graduate medical education or its equivalent as determined by the board; Hold certification from the educational commission for foreign medical graduates and have successfully completed not less than twenty-four months of graduate medical education through the second-year level of graduate medical education

kind.value: Graduate medical education (internship, residency, or clinical fellowship)
kind.quote: graduate medical education through the first-year level of graduate medical education

exams.name: Medical Licensing Examination
exams.quote: Have successfully passed an examination prescribed in rules adopted by the board to determine competency to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery

interval_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery shall be valid for a two-year period unless revoked or suspended. A license shall expire on the date that is two years from the date of issuance and may be renewed for additional two-year periods.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Each application shall be accompanied by a biennial renewal fee of three hundred five dollars.

required.quote: each person holding a license to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery issued by the state medical board shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education that has been approved by the board

hours_per_period.quote: shall complete biennially not less than fifty hours of continuing medical education

value: Domestic violence and its relationship to child abuse
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall approve one or more continuing medical education courses of study included within the programs certified by the Ohio state medical association and the Ohio osteopathic association under divisions (B)(1) and (2) of this section that assist doctors of medicine and doctors of osteopathic medicine in both of the following: (1) Recognizing the signs of domestic violence and its relationship to child abuse; (2) Diagnosing and treating chronic pain

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to an applicant if either of the following applies: (1) The applicant holds a license in another state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a substantially similar out-of-state license, be in good standing, meet education/training requirements, and comply with criminal records check
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to an applicant if either of the following applies: (1) The applicant holds a license in another state.

exists.quote: The state medical board shall review all applications submitted under section 4731.09 of the Revised Code and determine whether each applicant meets the requirements for a license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery

national_association.value: American Medical Association, American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: accredited by the liaison committee on medical education of the American medical association or the American osteopathic association

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice medicine and surgery, or any of its branches, without the appropriate license or certificate from the state medical board to engage in the practice.

credential_type.quote: the state medical board shall review all applications submitted under section 4731.09 of the Revised Code and determine whether each applicant meets the requirements for a license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice medicine and surgery, or any of its branches, without the appropriate license or certificate from the state medical board to engage in the practice.

title_protection.quote: The holder of a license to practice medicine and surgery issued under this chapter may use the titles "Dr.," "doctor," "M.D.," or "physician."

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice medicine and surgery, or any of its branches, without the appropriate license or certificate from the state medical board to engage in the practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud during examination administration or in applying for, renewing, or securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: found by the board to have committed fraud during the administration of the examination for a license or certificate to practice or to have committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or certificate to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting one's name or license to be used by another when not actually directing treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting one's name or one's license or certificate to practice to be used by a person, group, or corporation when the individual concerned is not actually directing the treatment given

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain minimal standards in selection or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain minimal standards applicable to the selection or administration of drugs, or failure to employ acceptable scientific methods in the selection of drugs or other modalities for treatment of disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, giving, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: selling, giving away, personally furnishing, prescribing, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes or a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction of, a violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution, or use of any drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statements in solicitation, advertising, or securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in the solicitation of or advertising for patients; in relation to the practice of medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, podiatric medicine and surgery, or a limited branch of medicine; or in securing or attempting to secure any license or certificate to practice issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to minimal standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A departure from, or the failure to conform to, minimal standards of care of similar practitioners under the same or similar circumstances, whether or not actual injury to a patient is established

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that an incurable disease or condition can be permanently cured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing, with the purpose of obtaining compensation or other advantage as personal gain or for any other person, that an incurable disease or injury, or other incurable condition, can be permanently cured

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of, or attempting to obtain, money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt of a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act that constitutes a felony in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an act that constitutes a felony in this state, regardless of the jurisdiction in which the act was committed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt of a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act in the course of practice that constitutes a misdemeanor in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an act in the course of practice that constitutes a misdemeanor in this state, regardless of the jurisdiction in which the act was committed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt of a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act involving moral turpitude that constitutes a misdemeanor in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an act involving moral turpitude that constitutes a misdemeanor in this state, regardless of the jurisdiction in which the act was committed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board upon a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board upon a license or certificate to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay license renewal fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to pay license renewal fees specified in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in division of fees for referral of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as authorized in section 4731.31 of the Revised Code, engaging in the division of fees for referral of patients, or the receiving of a thing of value in return for a specific referral of a patient to utilize a particular service or business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of a code of ethics of national professional organizations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to section 4731.226 of the Revised Code, violation of any provision of a code of ethics of the American medical association, the American osteopathic association, the American podiatric medical association, or any other national professional organizations that the board specifies by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental illness or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental illness or physical illness, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provisions of the chapter or rules adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate, any provisions of this chapter or any rule promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of abortion rules adopted by the director of health
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of section 3701.79 of the Revised Code or of any abortion rule adopted by the director of health pursuant to section 3701.341 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Limitation, revocation, or suspension of license by another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any of the following actions taken by an agency responsible for authorizing, certifying, or regulating an individual to practice a health care occupation or provide health care services in this state or another jurisdiction, for any reason other than the nonpayment of fees: the limitation, revocation, or suspension of an individual's license to practice; acceptance of an individual's license surrender; denial of a license; refusal to renew or reinstate a license; imposition of probation; or issuance of an order of censure or other reprimand

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of conditions for performing abortion or inducing abortion with knowledge of unmet conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of section 2919.12 of the Revised Code or the performance or inducement of an abortion upon a pregnant woman with actual knowledge that the conditions specified in division (B) of section 2317.56 of the Revised Code have not been satisfied or with a heedless indifference as to whether those conditions have been satisfied

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, reduction, or termination of clinical privileges by federal agencies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, restriction, reduction, or termination of clinical privileges by the United States department of defense or department of veterans affairs or the termination or suspension of a certificate of registration to prescribe drugs by the drug enforcement administration of the United States department of justice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination or suspension from participation in medicare or medicaid programs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Termination or suspension from participation in the medicare or medicaid programs by the department of health and human services or other responsible agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice because of substance use disorder or excessive use of drugs or alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care because of substance use disorder or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that may impair ability to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Second or subsequent violation of prescribing regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A second or subsequent violation of section 4731.66 or 4731.69 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Waiving payment of deductible or copayment as enticement to patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Waiving the payment of all or any part of a deductible or copayment that a patient, pursuant to a health insurance or health care policy, contract, or plan that covers the individual's services, otherwise would be required to pay if the waiver is used as an enticement to a patient or group of patients to receive health care services from that individual

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to use universal blood and body fluid precautions established by rules adopted under section 4731.051 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide notice to patient regarding lack of malpractice insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide notice to, and receive acknowledgment of the notice from, a patient when required by section 4731.143 of the Revised Code prior to providing nonemergency professional services, or failure to maintain that notice in the patient's medical record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of supervising physician to maintain supervision of physician assistant
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a physician supervising a physician assistant to maintain supervision in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 4730. of the Revised Code and the rules adopted under that chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to enter into or fulfill standard care arrangement with nurse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a physician or podiatrist to enter into a standard care arrangement with a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner with whom the physician or podiatrist is in collaboration pursuant to section 4731.27 of the Revised Code or failure to fulfill the responsibilities of collaboration after entering into a standard care arrangement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with terms of consult agreement with pharmacist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the terms of a consult agreement entered into with a pharmacist pursuant to section 4729.39 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate in board investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate in an investigation conducted by the board under division (F) of this section, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board or failure to answer truthfully a question presented by the board in an investigative interview, an investigative office conference, at a deposition, or in written interrogatories

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise anesthesiologist assistant in accordance with requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise an anesthesiologist assistant in accordance with Chapter 4760. of the Revised Code and the board's rules for supervision of an anesthesiologist assistant

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting suicide as defined in statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting suicide, as defined in section 3795.01 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with informed consent requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 2317.561 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise radiologist assistant in accordance with requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise a radiologist assistant in accordance with Chapter 4774. of the Revised Code and the board's rules for supervision of radiologist assistants

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing abortion at facility without required notice posted
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing or inducing an abortion at an office or facility with knowledge that the office or facility fails to post the notice required under section 3701.791 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with pain management clinic standards and procedures
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the standards and procedures established in rules under section 4731.054 of the Revised Code for the operation of or the provision of care at a pain management clinic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with pain management clinic supervision requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the standards and procedures established in rules under section 4731.054 of the Revised Code for providing supervision, direction, and control of individuals at a pain management clinic

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with drug database review requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 4729.79 or 4731.055 of the Revised Code, unless the state board of pharmacy no longer maintains a drug database pursuant to section 4729.75 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with abortion reporting requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 2919.171, 2919.202, or 2919.203 of the Revised Code or failure to submit to the department of health in accordance with a court order a complete report as described in section 2919.171 or 2919.202 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing at pain management clinic without proper licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing at a facility that is subject to licensure as a category III terminal distributor of dangerous drugs with a pain management clinic classification unless the person operating the facility has obtained and maintains the license with the classification

disciplinary_grounds.description: Owning pain management clinic without proper licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Owning a facility that is subject to licensure as a category III terminal distributor of dangerous drugs with a pain management clinic classification unless the facility is licensed with the classification

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with medical records requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any of the requirements regarding making or maintaining medical records or documents described in division (A) of section 2919.192, division (C) of section 2919.193, division (B) of section 2919.195, or division (A) of section 2919.196 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements before prescribing opioids to minors
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements in section 3719.061 of the Revised Code before issuing for a minor a prescription for an opioid analgesic, as defined in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with medical marijuana recommendation requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 4731.30 of the Revised Code or rules adopted under section 4731.301 of the Revised Code when recommending treatment with medical marijuana

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of continuous or repeated violations of telehealth prescribing rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of continuous or repeated violations of division (E)(2) or (3) of section 3963.02 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to fulfill responsibilities of collaboration agreement with athletic trainer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to fulfill the responsibilities of a collaboration agreement entered into with an athletic trainer as described in section 4755.621 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to take required steps following abortion when child born alive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to take the steps specified in section 4731.911 of the Revised Code following an abortion or attempted abortion in an ambulatory surgical facility or other location that is not a hospital when a child is born alive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of intimate examination consent requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of section 4731.77 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to supervise certified mental health assistant in accordance with requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a physician supervising a certified mental health assistant to maintain supervision in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 4772. of the Revised Code and the rules adopted under that chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with death certificate requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 3705.16 of the Revised Code when certifying a decedent's cause of death and completing and signing the medical certificate of death

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must hold certification from the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and complete 24 months of graduate medical education through the second-year level, and must demonstrate English language proficiency unless exempted
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Hold certification from the educational commission for foreign medical graduates and have successfully completed not less than twenty-four months of graduate medical education through the second-year level of graduate medical education or its equivalent as determined by the board

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: have successfully completed not less than twelve months of graduate medical education through the first-year level of graduate medical education or its equivalent as determined by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: The board shall approve one or more continuing medical education courses of study included within the programs certified by the Ohio state medical association and the Ohio osteopathic association under divisions (B)(1) and (2) of this section that assist doctors of medicine and doctors of osteopathic medicine in both of the following: (1) Recognizing the signs of domestic violence and its relationship to child abuse; (2) Diagnosing and treating chronic pain

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Physicians must comply with drug database review requirements before prescribing opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines, except in specified circumstances such as emergency treatment, hospice care, or prescriptions for 7 days or less
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Except as provided in divisions (C) and (E) of this section, a physician shall comply with all of the following as conditions of prescribing a drug that is either an opioid analgesic or a benzodiazepine, or personally furnishing a complete or partial supply of such a drug, as part of a patient's course of treatment for a particular condition: (1) Before initially prescribing or furnishing the drug, the physician or the physician's delegate shall request from the drug database a report of information related to the patient that covers at least the twelve months immediately preceding the date of the request

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: in the case of an applicant who prescribes or personally furnishes opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines, as defined in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code, the applicant shall certify to the board whether the applicant has been granted access to the drug database established and maintained by the state board of pharmacy pursuant to section 4729.75 of the Revised Code

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: Each owner shall supervise, control, and direct the activities of each individual, including an employee, volunteer, or individual under contract, who provides treatment of chronic pain at the pain management clinic or is associated with the provision of that treatment. The supervision, control, and direction shall be provided in accordance with rules adopted under this section.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may provide telehealth services and prescribe drugs through telehealth in accordance with standards established by the board, with equal standard of care as in-person services
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician may provide telehealth services in accordance with sections 4743.09 of the Revised Code

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The "Interstate Medical Licensure Compact" is hereby ratified, enacted into law, and entered into by the state of Ohio as a party to the compact with any other state that has legally joined in the compact

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any insurer providing professional liability insurance to an individual authorized to practice under this chapter, or any other entity that seeks to indemnify the professional liability of such an individual, shall notify the board within thirty days after the final disposition of any written claim for damages where such disposition results in a payment exceeding twenty-five thousand dollars

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Within thirty days after the imposition of any formal disciplinary action taken by any health care facility, including a hospital, health care facility operated by a health insuring corporation, ambulatory surgical center, or similar facility, against any individual holding a valid license or certificate to practice issued pursuant to this chapter, the chief administrator or executive officer of the facility shall report to the state medical board the name of the individual, the action taken by the facility, and a summary of the underlying facts leading to the action taken

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The state medical board shall establish a confidential, nondisciplinary program for the evaluation and treatment of practitioners and applicants who are, or may be, impaired and also meet the eligibility conditions described in section 4731.252 or 4731.253 of the Revised Code. The program shall be known as the confidential monitoring program.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board also may compel the individual to submit to a mental examination, physical examination, including an HIV test, or both a mental and a physical examination

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A treating physician may treat an eligible patient with an investigational drug, product, or device after securing the patient's informed consent in a signed statement
